a.xlink:title: Initialize an FDCAN peripheral for classic (non-FD) CAN operation.
Initialize a set of GPIO pins from a configuration table.
Read the state of the input register for the specific GPIO pin.
Configure the system, AHB, APB1, and APB2 clocks for a supported clock tree.
Attach the initialized USB device to the host.
Initialize the USB device hardware and endpoints.
Write a logic value to an output pin.
Enable FDCAN kernel + peripheral clocks (PCLK1)
Enter INIT mode and unlock configuration registers. Blocks until entered.
Leave INIT mode, ending configuration. Blocks until left.
Set TX FIFO/Queue mode to FIFO (not queue)
Write a filter action to RXGFC (accept/reject all)
Set up RX new message -> line 0, TX complete -> line 1.
Enable the AHB2 clock for bank's port (GPIOA-GPIOG).
Set AFR's field for pin. Caller must have validated pin <= 15.
Set MODER's field for pin to type. Caller must have validated pin <= 15.
Set OSPEEDR's field for pin. Caller must have validated pin <= 15.
Set OTYPER's field for pin. Caller must have validated pin <= 15.
Set PUPDR's field for pin. Caller must have validated pin <= 15.
Get the bit pattern for a pin's MODER field from its type.
Get the bit pattern for a pin's OSPEEDR field from its speed.
Get the bit pattern for a pin's OTYPER field from its output type.
Get the bit pattern for a pin's PUPDR field from its pull selection.
Disable HSI16 and block until it's off.
Enable HSI16 and block until it's ready.
Set the AHB, APB1, and APB2 prescalers to divide-by-1 (undivided)
Switch SYSCLK to HSE and block until the switch is confirmed.
Switch SYSCLK to HSI16 and block until the switch is confirmed.
Switch SYSCLK to the PLL and block until the switch is confirmed.
Attach to the bus by enabling the internal D+ pull-up.
Enable USB event interrupts and endpoint operation.
Enable and reset the USB hardware, configure pins and packet memory.
Queue one device-to-host packet.
